text:
Good afternoon desk staff,
Shift swaps came up at midday, so just a quick note

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk tight and steady through the rest of the shift. We have a full run of routine calls, check-in questions, and preflight guidance to keep clear and calm. Make sure every traveler gets the same patient, plain-language help, especially when someone is nervous about crate fit, feeding notes, or how their pet will handle the airport noise. If you need to step away, hand off cleanly so the next person is not chasing missing details.

Double-check each care plan before you confirm anything with the passenger. Species, temperament, comfort, and any special handling notes need to match the file and the conversation. If you see a mismatch, flag it right away and do not try to smooth it over on your own. We are better when we slow down for one minute and get it right than when we rush and create a mess for the gate team or the cabin crew.

Keep the tone warm, keep the facts simple, and keep the desk moving. If Keira Torres or Priya Rivera come through with changes, treat them like any other traveler: verify the details, document the update, and pass along only what the next team member needs. That is the standard at Aurelia Skyways, and I need everyone holding it firmly today.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
